content:
lina: FYI deploy-bot blocked publish of `worker:v1.9-20260321` — tag collision with different digest + attestation mismatch.

deploy-bot: publish-blocked: tag `worker:staging-20260321` exists -> digest sha256:aa11bb22, attempted publish sha256:cc33dd44. provenance mismatch (cosign).

lina: CI retried build, produced different digest but same date tag.

devops: quick unblock: retag desired digest to `staging-ephemeral-4420` and pin canary to digest. avoid overwriting the date tag.

michael: agree, pin digest in routing and update release notes to reference digest URI. open a GH issue to change CI tagging policy to include build-id.

lina: retagged and pinned canary -> sha256:cc33dd44, kicked canary.

deploy-bot: canary OK, route pinned. promotion eligible.

release-manager: noted. release notes edited with digest and explanation. follow-up: CI tagging fix and registry audit for other date-tags.
